name: Claude rotation
description: Spreads Claude Code chats across your saved accounts: each new chat starts on the one with the most left, and a chat that hits its limit moves to another for its next turn.
settings_description: Which Claude Code account each chat runs on.

settings.label: Rotate Claude Code chats
settings.description: New chats start on the saved account with the most left (the fewest chats on a tie), and a chat that hits its limit or signs out moves to another for its next turn. Your active account is never switched.
